title: Palm Jumeirah
description: This giant palm tree is an island, and people built all of it. Palm Jumeirah in Dubai was open sea until 2001. Would you live here? Imagery: Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics. Photos: Imre Solt (CC BY-SA 3.0), Wikimedia Commons. Source: Wikipedia.

beats.text: This giant palm tree is an island, and people built all of it.
It is Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, made by piling up sand and stone.
Work began in two thousand one. Before that, this was open sea.
Today more than twenty five thousand people live on it.
The outer ring is a breakwater. It shields the palm from waves.
But it trapped the water inside, so engineers had to cut gaps in it.
And a two thousand nine report said satellites measured it sinking, five millimeters a year.
